context: A chef and barista plan a high-end collab
purpose: Teach: 岡崎/星野/ウィリアム/デイヴィッド/ゲイツ/蘭/是非とも/アタック

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、岡崎ホテルとのコラボ、進めようか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, should we move forward with the Okazaki Hotel collaboration?
lines.style: Warm, upbeat Kansai drawl. Casual but focused. Leans in slightly on the question, inviting her into the decision. Breathy confidence — this is work he enjoys.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。星野リゾートとも、企画話、進んでます。
lines.en: Yes. We're also making progress on the Hoshino Resort partnership.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Slight uplift at the start — showing momentum. Steady pace, grounded. The careful optimism of someone reporting real progress, not overselling.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ウィリアム氏、デイヴィッド氏、ふたりとも世界的バリスタ。
lines.en: William and David — both world-class baristas.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost casual. Slight lean back. The tone of someone who knows exactly who these people are and why they matter. Not bragging, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ゲイツ財団系のカフェ運営とも、提携検討中ですか。
lines.en: Are we considering partnerships with Gates Foundation-affiliated cafes too?
lines.style: Quiet probe. Gentle forward lean. Curious, testing the scope of his thinking. Not skeptical — genuinely wanting to understand the scale. Soft uptick at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 蘭をテーマにした器、限定で出さへんか。
lines.en: What about doing a limited orchid-themed dishware release?
lines.style: Bright, animated pitch. Light, almost playful energy. Quick pace. The enthusiasm of someone floating an idea he thinks will land. Open-handed gesture in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 是非とも、季節フェアに合わせたいですね。
lines.en: Definitely — I'd love to time it with the seasonal fair.
lines.style: Genuinely animated now. Faster pace than before. The spark of an idea clicking into place. Warm agreement that builds slightly toward the end. Present, invested.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 最終フェーズのアタック、準備、よろしくな。
lines.en: Alright, final push — I'm counting on you for the prep.
lines.style: Affectionate directness. Slightly lower register, more intimate close. Confidence in her paired with trust. Not a command — a hand-off between partners. Warm exhale at the end.
